newsitem.title: USA: Fran's center 105 miles S-SE of the Carolinas.
newsitem.headline: Fran's center 105 miles S-SE of the Carolinas.

text.p: The center of Hurricane Fran was about 105 miles (169 km) south-southeast of the border of South Carolina and North Carolina as of 1500 EDT/1900 GMT Thursday, National Hurricane Center said.
Its center was near latitude 32.5 north and longitude 77.9 west and moving north-northwest near 16 mph (26 kmh).
"On this track, the center of the hurricane is expected to be near the coast within the warning area shortly before midnight," the Hurricane Center said.
But huricane force winds were expected to arrive on shore hours earlier.
Maximum sustained winds were near 115 mph (185 kmh), with higher gusts, making Fran a Category 3 hurricane. Little change in strength was expected before arrival.

Hurricane warnings were in effect from Edisto Beach, S.C., to North Carolina's border with Virginia, including Pamlico and Albemarle Sounds. A hurricane watch and tropical storm warning were in effect from north of the North Carolina-Virginia border to Chincoteague, Va. A tropical storm warning was in effect for the lower Chesapeake Bay.

Hurricane force winds were expected to spread inland as far as 100 miles (161 km) inland near Fran's path. Forecasters also warned of dangerously high tides and heavy rains, as well as isolated tornadoes.
